evidence: Three concrete, retrieval-oriented modes, each with severity/confidence/evidence/falsifier: 'Import-state invisibility' (high/high) — 'Scan excludes the manifest/log/cache files that explain duplicate export churn, so retrieval can over-trust the converted Markdown.'
'Duplicate meeting evidence' (medium/high) maps to verified fixture: client-kickoff-2026-06-21.md + ' copy' variant which is genuinely a sparser, divergent note.
'Raw transcript weak evidence' (medium/medium) maps to zoom-transcript-client-call.txt with [inaudible]/??? fragments and no decisions.
Each mode carries a 'Do not infer: the workspace is unusable or must be reorganized before capture' guard, avoiding moralizing language.
failures: No '## Non-Failures' and '## Ambiguities' sections, which the LOOP_SPEC template and ENZYME context both require ('Must name no material failure when a workspace is already indexable enough'). Healthy aspects (clean notes/ summary) never affirmatively named.

Coverage thinner than fixture supports: empty/malformed 'Untitled document.md', malformed headings / unclosed frontmatter (roadmap-2026-06-20.md cache parse error), and mixed/split date conventions are not named as distinct modes.

'Retrieval impact' line is identical across all three modes ('weak or misleading retrieval handles for setup and later meeting context') and identical to other cases — formulaic, not per-mode reasoning. 'Do not infer' line is also copy-pasted.
patch_recommendation: Patch failure-model instructions to (1) mandate '## Non-Failures' and '## Ambiguities' sections, (2) require a per-mode (not templated) Retrieval impact statement, and (3) require coverage of malformed/empty-conversion and mixed-date modes when fixture evidence (cache parse errors, manifest empty_file) supports them.
risk_notes: Modes present are concrete and evidence-backed (gate passes), but the templated retrieval-impact and missing Non-Failures section recur across all judged cases and are the strongest patch signal.
